evidence.excerpt:
Artificial intelligence increasingly drives automated scientific discovery, yet con-
temporary generalist agents lack physical grounding, frequently hallucinating
hardware-incompatible designs. Here, we present a physically grounded, multi-
agent discovery engine that autonomously architects hardware-compliant com-
puting systems. Anchored by an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph structuring past
scientific innovations, the framework extracts an "algorithmic Chain-of-Thought"
to transform blind stochastic search into directed structural evolution. Applied
to the extreme testbed of foundation model deployment, the engine evolved
two hardware-aware compression methodologies surpassing human-engineered
heuristics: Q-Enhance mitigates long-context accuracy loss in dense models, and
MoE-Salient-AQ outperforms state-of-the-art manual sparse Mixture-of-Experts
designs by 3.7% at sub-3-bit regimes.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The reported accuracy and hardware gains are corroborated by standard downstream benchmarks and direct physical deployment metrics rather than by the internal LLM reviewer scores.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established through empirical task benchmarks (MMLU, PIQA, ARC, LongEval) and physical hardware measurements of VRAM footprint, memory reduction, and inference speedup on compiled models.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The system optimizes candidate blueprints using EKG trajectory pre-screening scores and an automated AI peer-review rubric that filters and ranks generated algorithms.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported performance metrics (e.g., a 3.7% improvement at sub-3-bit regimes for MoE models, and 75% memory footprint reduction with minimal accuracy degradation) are supported by empirical tables and evaluation runs under specified physical constraints.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation includes both internal agent validation tiers and direct empirical physical benchmarking of the evolved algorithms on standardized tasks (e.g., MMLU, LongEval) across standard models (Llama-3, Qwen series) on real hardware setups (RTX 4090, dual-A100), demonstrating competitive accuracy and memory compression relative to established baselines.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance claims are validated using standard downstream academic benchmarks (e.g., MMLU, PIQA, ARC) and direct hardware execution metrics rather than relying solely on the internal LLM review score.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Empirical task benchmarks (such as MMLU, PIQA, LongEval) and physical hardware measurements (VRAM footprint, inference latency) on compiled models.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Trajectory pre-screening scores and an automated multi-dimensional AI peer reviewer filtering candidate blueprints.

primary.limitations: The authors transparently discuss the current reliance on manual auditing for initial EKG construction and the challenges posed by stochastic LLM reasoning for strict deterministic guarantees.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing the EKG schema, the specialized multi-agent roles (Analyzer, Ideator, Architect, Reviewer, and execution agent), the offline trajectory pre-screening, and the translation of blueprints into physical implementations using kernel integration and sensitivity profiles.
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides a substantive scoped contribution combining multi-agent architecture search with rigorous physical instantiation and standard empirical benchmark testing, demonstrating clear methodology and aligned claims.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript introduces an autonomous multi-agent discovery framework anchored by an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph (EKG) and sensitivity profiling to synthesize and instantiate hardware-compliant compression algorithms, specifically evolving Q-Enhance for dense LLMs and MoE-Salient-AQ for sparse models.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides a substantive scoped contribution combining multi-agent architecture search with rigorous physical instantiation and standard empirical benchmark testing, demonstrating clear methodology and aligned claims.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently discuss the current reliance on manual auditing for initial EKG construction and the challenges posed by stochastic LLM reasoning for strict deterministic guarantees.
